company_blurb: Aurora Freight coordinates cross-border Nordic rail and road logistics from its Helsinki hub. The company builds proprietary routing software and manages customs clearance, cold-chain freight scheduling, and fleet capacity for regional manufacturing and retail clients.

departments.culture: Engineering values predictable deployments, clear runbooks, and pragmatic code reviews. Teams work in two-week sprints, Pair-debug production telemetry anomalies when winter storms delay transit hubs, and document architectural tradeoffs in shared specs before writing new services.

Finance runs on structured close calendars, clean ledger reconciliations, and exact cost attribution per shipping lane. Colleagues double-check cross-currency freight settlements calmly, share spreadsheet macros openly, and keep audit documentation tidy year-round.

Legal emphasizes thorough regulatory checklists, clear contract language, and timely sign-offs on customs and carrier frameworks. The team balances strict EU transport compliance with practical turnaround times so commercial freight operations keep moving on schedule.

Sales moves at a steady, metric-driven pace centered on lane utilization, seasonal freight tenders, and client retention. Account executives and ops specialists collaborate closely on rate tables and capacity forecasts without overpromising delivery windows.
